name: disk-guard
summary: A read-only check that says whether there is enough free disk to start a build, before the disk fills and writes start failing.

env.HUBKIT_HOME: install root, default ~/.claude/hubkit (the log goes under $HUBKIT_HOME/state)
env.DISK_GUARD_WARN_GI: WARN below this many GiB free, default 20
env.DISK_GUARD_CRIT_GI: CRIT below this many GiB free, default 5
env.DISK_GUARD_PATH: check the disk holding this folder, default $HUBKIT_HOME or your home
